ideas.truth: A well-made object doesn't need a story added to it — it just needs the right light to be seen in.
ideas.moment: No people. The last minute of daylight on a Goa beach, when the sky turns molten and even a still object looks like it's part of the view.
ideas.key_frame: The bag, untouched, now resting against a Goa sunset — deep orange sky, the sun low over the Arabian Sea, soft sand and gentle surf behind it.

ideas.truth: The best part of a trip is the pause right before you put your bag down and just look at the view.
ideas.moment: A traveller sets the bag on the sand and turns toward the water as the sun drops, shoes in hand.
ideas.key_frame: Bag in the foreground on wet sand; a barefoot silhouette walks toward the surf under a burnt-orange Goa sky.

ideas.truth: A good bag doesn't just survive the journey — it belongs in the postcard moment at the end of it.
ideas.moment: An evening beach walk in Goa, the bag slung over a shoulder as the last light hits the water.
ideas.key_frame: Rear three-quarter view of someone walking along the shoreline, bag on shoulder, sunset sky reflected on wet sand.

why: The customer's ask was literal and precise — swap the background only, keep the bag exactly as shot. Adding a person or narrative moment risks altering the product's presentation; the no-people idea honours the brief exactly while still delivering the emotional lift of the Goa sunset.
treatment: We open on the bag, unchanged in every detail — same angle, same light on its surface, same shadow falling the way it always did. But now it sits against a Goa beach at golden hour: the sky a deep orange fading to violet, the sun low and soft over the Arabian Sea, gentle waves catching the last light, warm sand stretching behind it. Nothing about the bag moves or shifts — not its colour, not its texture, not its position in frame. Only the world around it has changed, as if it had simply been picked up and set down somewhere more beautiful. The final image feels calm, warm, and effortless — the product exactly as it was, just seen in better light.

scenes.prompt: Change only the background to a Goa beach at sunset — warm orange-to-violet sky, the sun low over the Arabian Sea, soft golden light, gentle waves rolling onto warm sand. Keep everything else exactly the same: the bag, its colours, its material and texture, its label, its exact position and angle, its shadow direction, and the original framing.
scenes.first_frame_still_prompt: The bag from the reference photo, completely unchanged, now placed against a Goa beach at sunset: burnt-orange sky, soft low sun, calm surf, warm sand — same framing and lighting on the bag as the original shot.

finish.copy_placement: No on-screen copy needed — this is a pure product background swap. If a logo is required, place it small in the bottom-right corner, added by code post-edit.
